A photo from a walk on 2026-03-21.
📷 OM-3 & 75 mm ƒ1.8

photos.alt: A photo of the three tall oaks standing in the forest among much smaller trees. The three trunks are brightened by the sun, and they're slightly twisting when going up. Only the trunks with a few branches are seen in the frame. Under the trees, the ground is covered with fallen leaves, but there is enough greenery to give a sense of an early spring.
